title: Oct 10 Results + Oct 11 Preview: Perfect Pitch on a Quiet Night
summary: Clean sweep on Oct 10 with Cleveland. Tomorrow, we're betting against Skubal in Milwaukee.

content.value:
## Looking Back: October 10th

Sometimes the best days are the quiet ones. One game on the slate, one pick to make, and one checkmark in the win column. The Guardians took care of business at home against the Sox, just like we thought they would at 53%. Nothing fancy, nothing dramatic—just a solid call that hit when it needed to.

## Tomorrow's Spotlight: October 11th

Now here's where it gets interesting. The Dodgers roll into Milwaukee, and they're sending Tarik Skubal to the mound—one of the most dominant arms in baseball right now. You'd think that'd make LA the easy play, right?

Not so fast.

Our model is leaning Brewers at 61%, and I've seen enough baseball to know that home teams with live arms can absolutely ambush even the best visitors. Jacob Misiorowski gets the ball for Milwaukee, and American Family Field has a way of amplifying young pitchers when the crowd gets behind them.

## The Misiorowski Factor

I'll be honest—betting against Tarik Skubal feels like stepping in front of a freight train. The guy's been unhittable at times this season. But that 61% confidence in Milwaukee tells me the model sees something in the matchup, probably in how the Brewers have performed at home and how Misiorowski stacks up in this particular spot.

This is the kind of pick that separates the data-driven approach from gut feelings. Sometimes you have to trust the numbers even when conventional wisdom says otherwise. We're not picking the Brewers because they're the better team—we're picking them because the situation favors them enough to move the needle to 61%.

## The Bottom Line

Perfect night on October 10th keeps the momentum rolling. Tomorrow's a different animal entirely—going contrarian against one of baseball's elite pitchers isn't for the faint of heart. But if you've been around long enough, you know that October baseball is about matchups, not reputations.

Let's see if Milwaukee can make us look smart.
